head: PaliCAD is a 3D CAD app for iPhone and iPad, without a subscription
dek: PaliCAD lets you sketch in 2D and build 3D models by touch or Apple Pencil, offline, for a one-time price. It was #20 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: It's aimed at makers and hobbyists for simple to moderately complex designs, with direct modeling, sketch-to-extrude and common CAD file formats. It costs $6.99 with in-app purchases, by Brayden Nilsen, and needs iOS 16.
means: If you 3D print or build things, you can model parts on your phone or tablet without a monthly fee.
todo: Find PaliCAD in the App Store; an Apple Pencil helps on iPad.
